svg.title: Accessibility — focus, keyboard and high contrast
svg.desc: Focus rings, non-color state cues, keyboard behavior, zoom requirements and a high-contrast skin using the same components.
svg.text: Targets, focus, contrast and motion are skin invariants. Accessibility is not a separate “ugly mode”.
Space: play/pause when not typing or on a button.
Up/Down: volume 1% when transport has focus.
Esc: close top overlay or leave focus view.
200% text: no clipped actions or overlapping labels.
320 CSS px equivalent: core playback remains usable.
400% browser zoom: verify equivalent reflow behavior.
No horizontal scroll for core playback at compact width.
Respect OS reduced motion; offer an in-app override.

g.text: N O R T H B O U N D

svg.text: SVG artwork is a design artifact. Production exposes native/HTML semantics, names, roles, values and live announcements.
